sermon.title: Declare, Delay, Deliver
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: A heavenly messenger came to Daniel after a 21-day delay caused by the prince of Persia. God declares, delays to work in us, then delivers. Our weapons are spiritual—prayer, not self-help books. The disciples waited ten days before the Spirit came.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.short_answer: A heavenly being with a message—all visitations come with a message.
chunks.text:
Daniel chapter 10 starts out with this or uh Daniel seeing this heavenly being after mourning and fasting for 3 weeks, 31 days. A certain man clothed in linen, a belt of gold, a body of beryl, a stone, when it’s pure, it’s crystal clear. The face was as lightning, his eyes of fire, arms and feet like polished brass, and the voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude. Now, how many of you know, if you’ve seen something like that, it would stop you in your tracks? Uh it would get your attention, yeah. Lightning face and all this stuff. Wow. Nowhere in the Bible is another creature described like this. But I’ll tell you one thing, that would get my attention really quick.

And so, this guy comes and he says to Daniel, he has a message. All visitations from God have a message. If you see an angel, I’m interested in the message, not your vision of an angel. I’m interested in what God’s got to say, and if it doesn’t line up with things, I don’t know. From the first day that you set your heart to understand, the guy said, “From the first day you set your heart to understand and to discipline or chasten yourself before God, this is what this guy’s words were. From the very first day you started to discipline yourself and lift up your voice in prayer, he said, ‘Your words were here, heard from the very first day.

And I am come for your words.’ Hallelujah. What brought this heavenly being? Daniel disciplined himself, setting aside some time, disciplining his body to pray and seek God audibly speaking. None of this thinking stuff, but audibly speaking prayers. And he heard him from the first day. Okay? Now, if that’s true, if God heard him the first day, why did it take 21 days for the message to get there? We call it the promise, the problem or the preparation, and the provision.

You see, from the time you get a promise or a potential from God, you can be something in God. There has to be a preparation. There is going to be problems. There’s going to be conflicts before you’re going to be provided with the promise. And us Christians don’t like that. We want to name it, claim it, ask it, receive it, bamboo jumbo, popcorn, did it dot. But a lot of times we need preparation. And if we don’t need preparation, like Daniel, he didn’t need any preparation, it was a delay. So, we call it the declaration, the delay, and then the delivery. And Christians don’t like that. God promises things in the Bible that we know are our But then God delays doing it, and we try to make it work on our own strength, and it won’t work.

scriptures.text_nkjv: I lifted my eyes and looked, and behold, a certain man clothed in linen, whose waist was girded with gold of Uphaz! His body was like beryl, his face like the appearance of lightning, his eyes like torches of fire, his arms and feet like burnished bronze in color, and the sound of his words like the voice of a multitude. And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me did not see the vision; but a great terror fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves. Therefore I was left alone when I saw this great vision, and no strength remained in me; for my vigor was turned to frailty in me, and I retained no strength. Yet I heard the sound of his words; and while I heard the sound of his words I was in a deep sleep on my face, with my face to the ground. Suddenly, a hand touched me, which made me tremble on my knees and on the palms of my hands. And he said to me, “O Daniel, man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have now been sent to you.” While he was speaking this word to me, I stood trembling. Then he said to me, “Do not fear, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard; and I have come because of your words.

Come in here.” Then he opened their heart to understand who he was and revealed himself to him in the breaking of the bread. Now, David waited 15 years before becoming king after chosen to be king.

Okay, and there was a little horn in that Rome that magnified himself to the prince of the host, took away the daily sacrifice, warred with and destroyed the saints, and cast down the sanctuary, and cast down truth. Little horns have been in every generation trying to undermine the Bible and undermine mind Jesus and undermine the truth. That’s just a memory. So, he’s still talking about these kingdoms, that’s what I’m telling you. He’s still talking about these kingdoms and this kingdom of the north and kingdom of the south.

He names who they are. He names the kingdom of the south plain, just flat out tells us who the kingdom of the south is in Daniel 11 and 12. These princes that this angelic being, this spirit being is fighting with is not the prince of Persia, it’s not Alexander the Great and the four kingdoms and kings that came after him. We know he’s not talking about an earthly king, is he? Yeah. He goes on to say, “I will show you that which is noted or inscribed in the scripture.” He’s showing him things are already been written in the Bible. Did you read that?

Yeah, he said, “I’m going to show you what’s inscribed in the scriptures.” They’re there in the Psalms. They’re there in the prophets. Whoa. See, I don’t have to get weird with the book of Daniel. Then he says, “There is none that holds with me, supports me in these things, but Michael, your prince.” Okay? So, who is our prince, ruler in heaven that’s fighting for us? Michael. Jesus, too. But there’s other rulers in heaven. There’s no one supporting this but Michael, your prince. Jesus sent Michael to handle this low-class warfare.

He didn’t even get off his throne. He just sent Michael down. You see, we have someone in heaven heaven fighting for us. Just as the people of the kingdom of darkness have someone in the spirit world fighting, we have someone fighting for us. And uh Michael is our prince. Now, in Revelations, it says, “There was war in heaven.” Revelations 12. Michael. Oh, you heard that name before? Michael and his angels his spirit beings fought against the dragon, the Devil and his spirit being.

Are you getting the picture, church? There is a warfare going on in the heavens and it’s in proportion to what we’re doing on the earth. If we become lukewarm complacent Christians we’re not winning the war in heaven to bring results in the earth. But when we do our part then God by his eternal promise that he cannot change, he cannot lie, brings results. And the Devil was cast out. There was no place anymore in heaven for them. chunks.short_answer: Prayer, not a book for every problem—a wealthy ruler couldn’t save his daughter; My house is a house of prayer; they waited 10 days for the Spirit.
chunks.text:
You get a book for every problem you got and you still aren’t solving them. It’s amazing that we get so many books written and then we say the Bible is the answer. But we can’t go to the Bible and get answer. We’ve got to go to some book. And then nothing is working for us. Are you with me? Yeah. Now, 2 Timothy 3:16, all scripture. How much scripture? All of it. Genesis through Revelation is given to us. It’s by the inspiration of God and it’s profitable for doctrine. You can’t get your doctrine out of church bylaws. You got to get your doctrine out of the Bible. For reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness. That Bible is always trying to correct you.

Then it says this, that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped, fully furnished for every good work. You see, we can’t just take a few weapons to win this war. We need them all. We can’t just take what we like. We need them all. But Christians, they they they they they just take what they like. I like worship. I like praise. I like helping the poor. Helping the poor isn’t even a weapon. [clears. Okay, you ready for the weapons? Throat] Prayer.

What was Daniel doing? Praying. Okay. Praise and thanksgiving. Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou has ordained praise to still the enemy and the avenger. Folks, praise is important and thanksgiving’s important. You can have your own ideas if you want to, but God said praise will still the enemy and the avenger. And what do we need stilled in America? The enemy, the spiritual enemy and the avenger. What do we need stilled in the church world? The spiritual enemy, the avenger. And God is saying, folks, here’s a weapon. Praise me. Exalt me. Boast of me and I WILL STILL THE ENEMY IN YOUR LIFE AND OTHERS. WORSHIP. The rich man, he had all this money and yet his daughter died.

He was wealthy. He was a ruler. And yet all of his authority couldn’t keep his daughter from dying. He came to Jesus. And instead of saying, “Man, I’ll give money. I’ll you know, I’ll give money. I’ll give a big offering. Just heal my No, he came and he worshipped Jesus. He worshipped Jesus. That’s why I separated worship. They’re really the same stream. Praise, worship, Thanksgiving, all the same stream. But that humbleness to worship, go to the king. Jesus himself as this song said as they uh and worship this morning. And Jesus raised that girl from the dead. Are you there? You say you got children or you got parents or you got relatives or you got neighbors.

Go and humble yourself before this man Jesus. And you’ll be surprised of what he can do. Hallelujah. Learn and apply the word. You know, the wise man that built his house on the rock wasn’t wise because he heard. He was wise because he heard and applied the word. You know, we think we’re wise because we can quote the Bible. Oh, I’m I meet them all the time. It’s not being able to quote the Bible. It’s applying the Bible. Love your wife as Christ loved the church.

Wives, love your husbands. Give honor to Children, love your parents. Parents, love your children. Come on, application. Don’t nag. Don’t shoot your mouth off. Come on. Is God waiting on us? Yeah, we think we’re waiting on God. Oh, we nag. Oh, God. And when they nag back, we get mad. Yeah, you’re grinning because you know you’re guilty. And then we come into church and we do our little Woo, yeah. And nothing is happening. Why? Because we got to get this Bible morality down. We got to get the application of the word.

God said, “My house is to be a house of prayer.” And I’ll bet you 85% of you didn’t spend 1 hour total this week in prayer. Total. And then we wonder, “Why why isn’t God moving?” From the rising of the sun to the going down, my name is to be praised. You know, you can praise him while you’re going down the road. You can praise him while you’re washing your hands in the bathroom. You can praise him while you’re doing dishes. You know, you can discipline yourself. Are you with me? Tithe. Offering. Malachi 3. Anybody know it? You’re robbers of God.

They go, “Why are we robbers of God?” Because you don’t pay God your tithes and your offering. You’re taking God’s money and using it for your benefit. He says if you tithe, if you give offerings, you put your money where your mouth is, I will rebuke the devourer. Now, is that a weapon? Yeah. And I will open the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing. Is God waiting on us? Yeah. Assembling together, even the more so, as you see the day approaching, provoking one another to love and to good works. You see. Assembling together.

The church in Russia before the iron curtain come down put their lives on the line to assemble together. In America, we won’t assemble at the drop of a hat. We won’t assemble if there’s a football game on. But why? Cuz we don’t understand that there is a warfare going on between good and evil, between light and darkness. We just don’t get it. And our application of these weapons of war. Now, on the day of Pentecost when the Holy Spirit came, were they assembled together? Were they praying? Were they worshipping? Yes. Were they applying the word that they heard? Yeah, you can go right down the line. And then what happened after 10 days?

They waited 10 days and the Holy Spirit came. They didn’t quit the second day, the third day, the fourth day. They went the whole 10 days. They didn’t even know it was 10 days. Are you with me, church? I submit to you we have the keys to the solutions of America, the solutions of the church, and the solutions of the harvest field. And God is waiting for us to get the understanding, and you just got it today. This is a kindergarten class. This is basic Bible. Folks, we can never fail when we try. Amen? Because above everything, God looks and honors the heart.

And don’t you don’t you hinder yourself and dismiss yourself because you think you’re a failure. Listen, you got to keep trying. Remember what Psalms 81 said? If you’d have just kept doing what I asked you to do, I would soon have answered your need. So, don’t ever quit. Just keep doing it. Now, we know to praise, we know to worship, we know to sing, we know all these weapons. And if you’re willing today to say, “Hey, I’m going to be a source to transform America, to transform the church, I am going to exercise my weapons, and I’m going to move heaven so that he can move earth.” Will you stand with me and let’s sing?

scriptures.text_nkjv: And behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue came, Jairus by name. And when he saw Him, he fell at His feet and begged Him earnestly, saying, “My little daughter lies at the point of death. Come and lay Your hands on her, that she may be healed, and she will live.”
And He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of thieves.’ ”

When the Day of Pentecost had fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting. Then there appeared to them divided tongues, as of fire, and one sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
